tagline: Allows enola's read-only architecture query tools; snapshot writes keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed enola MCP tools and the surrounding Guard policy.
Only package launches of enola-cli through uvx or pipx are matched; an enola binary installed by the shell installer or RubyGems and launched directly stays on Guard's normal handling.
